name: Lançamento de Livro | 2026 | ABC da Guerra
description: This event is the launch of the book "ABC da Guerra" by João de Sousa Cardoso, featuring ten essays based on his conference series at Teatro São Luiz. The book analyzes dramatic texts about war, its damages, and victims, with a presentation by Pedro Mexia.
longDescription:
The book launch for "ABC da Guerra" by João de Sousa Cardoso takes place at Teatro Nacional São João. The book compiles ten essays from his conference series at Teatro São Luiz, exploring dramatic texts that address war, its consequences, and its victims. The selected plays span from 1936 to 2014, including works by Karl Valentin, Bertolt Brecht, Tennessee Williams, and Jorge de Sena.

The publication also includes visual documentation from the hybrid conference-theater sessions and the invited performers who read excerpts. The event features the author, João de Sousa Cardoso, and a presentation by poet, chronicler, and literary critic Pedro Mexia.

Admission is free until the room reaches its capacity. Standing places may be available, also subject to room capacity. The event is scheduled for November 17, 2026, at 19:00, with a duration of 90 minutes.

As peças selecionadas vão de 1936 a 2014, incluindo trabalhos de Karl Valentin, Bertolt Brecht, Tennessee Williams e Jorge de Sena.

A publicação inclui também documentação visual das sessões híbridas de conferência-teatro e dos artistas convidados que leram excertos. O evento conta com a presença do autor, João de Sousa Cardoso, e uma apresentação do poeta, cronista e crítico literário Pedro Mexia.
